pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Menu (the Menu engine) opened as a context menu at the pointer or at the focused element; roving focus with real DOM focus on items.

roles.role: unchanged (no role or ARIA attributes are added)

aria.value: The label option, default localized 'Context menu'
"true"; the item stays focusable but is not activatable

keyboard.context: Focus inside the target, not disabled
keyboard.action: Opens the menu at the focused element and focuses the first enabled item.
Next / previous item, wrapping. Disabled items receive focus.
Focus the next item whose label starts with the typed characters.
Activates the item (closes, restores focus, emits aui-select), toggles a checkbox or checks a radio, or opens a submenu.
Same as Enter; with closeOnSelect=false, toggles checkbox/radio items without closing.
Opens the submenu and focuses its first item.
Closes the submenu and returns focus to its parent item.
Closes that submenu only and returns focus to its parent item.
Closes the menu and restores focus to the previously focused element; an enclosing Dialog stays open.
Closes all levels, restores focus, and lets the browser move focus on from there.

focus: Opening moves real DOM focus to the first enabled item. Activation, Escape at the top level, Tab, and close() with focus inside restore focus to the element focused before opening (not the body), else to the target when it is focusable. Outside presses and focus moving elsewhere close without moving focus.
notes: The target receives no ARIA attributes, so nothing announces the context menu: describe it (for example aria-describedby text 'Press Shift+F10 for actions') or show a visible hint.
Never put actions only in a context menu; offer each one through a visible control as well (2.1.1, discoverability).
Keyboard access uses Shift+F10 and the ContextMenu key at the focused element, so descendants must be focusable for per-row keyboard use.
Popups are appended to the enclosing <dialog> so they are not inert inside a modal Dialog; each level is a separate overlay-stack entry.
Right-clicking inside the open popup never shows the native menu over it.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
Inside an enabled target the native browser menu is not reachable from the keyboard (Shift+F10 and the ContextMenu key always open the component menu).
